title: Guillaume Dupaix International Master's Scholarship
description: Scholarship for outstanding master's students from any country admitted to an eligible programme at the University of Luxembourg, with no application fee and no separate English test required for admission.
amount: EUR 10,000 to EUR 11,000 per academic year for up to two years, part of which covers university residence accommodation

title: University of Luxembourg Doctoral Positions
description: Salaried doctoral positions advertised by the University of Luxembourg's faculties and interdisciplinary centres, open to applicants of any nationality holding a relevant master's degree.
amount: Full-time employment contract with a competitive salary (around EUR 38,000 per year gross) plus social security

title: FNR AFR PhD and Postdoc Grants
provider: Luxembourg National Research Fund (Fonds National de la Recherche, FNR)
description: Grants supporting doctoral and postdoctoral researchers of any nationality to carry out their project at a Luxembourg research institution, or in a public-private partnership.
amount: Salary/stipend funding for up to 48 months (PhD) plus a contribution to research and mobility costs

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Luxembourg-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, some coordinated by or including the University of Luxembourg. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
